evals.name: performance-compare-against-planning-baseline
evals.expected_output: Runs the `compare` phase: retrieves the baseline captured at planning time from the topic's memory-tier baselines directory, measures the after-state under the same conditions, and verifies the improvement claim. If no baseline exists, reports honestly that improvement cannot be quantified — does not fabricate numbers.
expectations: Looks for a baseline in the topic's memory-tier baselines directory (captured at planning time, not here)
Compares after-state to baseline under the SAME conditions; CONFIRMED only on clear improvement with sound methodology
If no baseline exists, states "cannot quantify improvement" rather than fabricating a delta

evals.name: metrics-vs-review-gate-boundary
evals.expected_output: Applies the `metrics` family: MEASURE a code-metrics delta (complexity / coverage / CRAP) before→after vs the planning-time baseline, verifying an improvement claim. Distinct from a review gate, which REVIEWS design quality for ship-readiness (absolute axis). Reads context/metrics.md.
expectations: Measures a metric delta (before→after) rather than reviewing for ship-readiness
Distinguishes itself from a review gate (measure-delta vs review-for-ship); does not route metric measurement into a review skill

evals.name: baseline-phase-routed-from-planning
evals.expected_output: Runs the `baseline` phase (the planning-stage routing target for plans with a measurable perf goal): identifies the claim precisely, chooses metrics matching it, checks the noise floor, and captures pre-change measurements under controlled conditions — stored in the topic's memory-tier baselines directory (never committed) with baseline + target recorded in the plan.
expectations: Captures the PRE-change state (multiple runs, mean ± std, warm-up discarded) — does not measure after the change and call it a baseline
Stores measurements in the topic's memory-tier baselines directory and records baseline + target in the plan
Surfaces the noise-floor argument BEFORE the work if projected savings sit within run-to-run variance

evals.name: outcome-confirmation-routes-to-verify-changes
evals.prompt: /verify-improvement — did we build everything the plan asked for?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes an intent/outcome-confirmation request (plan-vs-implementation match) and routes to /verify-changes rather than measuring a delta. /verify-improvement only verifies measurable-improvement claims against a baseline.
expectations: Reserves itself for measurable-improvement claims (performance or code metrics) with a baseline/compare shape
